item.description:
### Added - **Perch works with Rex.** For agents running in Rex, Superlogical's terminal: - **Jump to the agent.** Clicking a session brings Rex to the front and focuses the agent's pane. To have Rex switch to that session as well, turn on Remote Control in Rex's Settings, under Rex Server. - **Reply from your iPhone.** Your message goes into the agent's own pane, even when another pane or session is in front. - **Stop from your iPhone,** for Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Droid. - **No reply or Stop while a prompt is up.** While the agent shows an approval or a question, answer that first, with Allow or Deny or at the Mac. Perch won't send a message or Stop then, because either one would answer the prompt for you. - **No Reply field on Mac notifications** for sessions in Rex yet.
### Fixed - **A resumed session opens in the right terminal.** A session started in one terminal and resumed in another could bring the first terminal to the front when you clicked it.
